description: Canberra T.4 (solid nose, bubble canopy) preserved on the tarmac, photographed by Sanjay Simha (WBI). Identity not recorded.
MiG-25R preserved at AFS Bareilly (Bharat Rakshak, with photo); WBI notes two MiG-25 airframes on base, one at the main gate and one at the war memorial near ATC.
Second MiG-25 airframe preserved at Bareilly seen on Google Earth (WBI); identity unknown, possibly KP-3106 (a U trainer) as once suggested.
Folland-built Gnat c/n GT-012 pylon-mounted in the technical area (WBI; Bharat Rakshak).
Su-7BMK ex-221 Sqn (1971) preserved at AFS Bareilly per Bharat Rakshak.
